_readme: STARTER DATA. Every entry is verified:false. Check each scheme against its official guidelines, then fix the fields and set verified:true and last_checked. Rules use profile fields: owns_land (bool), occupation (list), is_society_member (bool), state (str). ops: eq, any_of, truthy

schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.summary: Income support for landholding farmer families.
exclusions: Check the official exclusion list (for example institutional landholders, income tax payers, serving or retired government employees).
schemes.where_to_apply: Common Service Centre, local agriculture office or the official portal

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.summary: Credit card for crop and allied-activity credit needs from banks and cooperative credit societies.

rules.label: Farmer, tenant or sharecropper, or engaged in dairy, fisheries or poultry

schemes.where_to_apply: Your cooperative credit society, cooperative bank or commercial bank branch

schemes.name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (crop insurance)
schemes.summary: Insurance cover against crop loss for notified crops in notified areas.

rules.label: Farmer, tenant or sharecropper growing notified crops

exclusions: Cover depends on the crop and area being notified for the season. Check cut-off dates.
schemes.where_to_apply: Bank, cooperative society, Common Service Centre or the official portal
